welcome.title: Welcome to Family Tree
welcome.body: This quick tour walks you through the main features. You can relaunch it any time from the user menu.

create-tree.title: Create your first workspace
create-tree.body: Click Next to open the dialog where your first workspace gets created.

existing-tree.title: Continue with this workspace
existing-tree.body: You already have a workspace selected, so we will skip setup and jump straight into the everyday tools.

add-member.title: Add your first person
add-member.body: Click here to add a person to the tree. Once added, you can edit their details and link them to parents, children, and partners.

sidebar-panel.title: Your sidebar
sidebar-panel.body: Switch between your workspaces at the top. At the bottom you’ll find your account menu and the display preferences (theme, language, line style).

switch-views.title: Navigate between views
switch-views.body: Every view lives here: the tree, people, timeline, map, photos and documents under Explore, and statistics and data quality under Insights. Let’s open Workspaces next.

tree-management.title: Workspaces
tree-management.body: From here you can create new workspaces, share an existing workspace with friends as a viewer or editor, and import or export your data.

friends.title: Friends & sharing
friends.body: Search for other users by username, send a friend request, and once accepted you can invite them to any of your workspaces.

finish.title: You're all set!
finish.body: That's the tour. You can relaunch it any time from the user menu in the sidebar. Enjoy building your family tree!

tree-name.title: Name your workspace
tree-name.body: We've started you off with a name — you can rename your workspace any time later. Click Next to create it.
